title: 第526章 解了心病第525章 收拾张雪2
content_zh:
第526章解了心病
张雪还做着自己的富太太的美梦，而这个时候陈楚已经开始在回味和吸收整理自己得到的至阴之气了。
在和张雪在一起的时候，张雪的至阴之气达到了85%。当然这些至阴之气不是很纯净，里面夹杂着太多的利益的纠葛。
而陈楚也觉得85%已经不少了，毕竟是个雏。而且这个家伙自己不捷足先登，可能也会被其他的男的得到，只要有钱有势，这个张雪肯定会奉献的。
而且她现在已经是大二年级，大专三年，在今年她不给自己找一个归宿，再过一两年就不值钱了。
而且张雪这种人只爱自己，从来不爱别人。能够因为利益的纠缠对自己的感情升温到了85%已经很难得了。
陈楚这个时候再次整理自己的小世界内的范围，从1700平方公里达到了1900平方公里，虽然比之前的进展都要小，但这也已经很不容易了。这个张雪自己对她就是废物利用已经物尽其责了。
搞完了之后，陈楚打电话给表弟陈明：“小明，跟你说个事。”
陈明那边叹了口气，声音坚定地说：“大哥是不是把那个张雪这贱人给拿下了？”
“没错。小明你生气吗？”
“小哥我生啥气呀？我感谢你还来不及呢。那个贱人真是把我害惨了，我当了她两年的舔狗，没想到让小哥你短短几天就拿下了，对这种女人根本就不值得。”
“我这样，没错，小明你现在可以去找他要钱了，他现在一定会把钱给你。”
陈主明白表弟的心结就是那两万块钱，他一颗善良的心灵被骗了。这个场子必须找回来，自己的钱必须自己要回来，别人给的20万200万都解不开这个心结了。
“好的，小哥，我听你的。”
“小明，用我出主意告诉你怎么去做吗？”
“不用了，小哥。我明白了。”
此时的陈明心思无比的通达。和陈楚通完电话之后，陈明便直接给张雪打去电话，只是打了几个电话张雪都不接。
陈明直接到了医高专学校，他本身就是二十二三岁的样子，直接进了校园，门卫也没有拦截他。
随后到了张雪公寓的楼下，大声的喊了起来：“张雪，你给我下来，你欠我这两万块钱什么时候还给我？”
刚咋呼了几声躺在楼上的张雪便起身下了楼：“陈明，原来是你这个穷鬼，你来找我干什么？”

“张雪，既然你骂我是穷鬼，你肯定是不缺钱了。那你骗我的那两万块钱，咱们今天也该算算了。”
“放屁，老娘啥时候骗你的两万块钱了？都是你自己贱，愿意给老娘花的。”
“呵呵，是吗张雪？既然这么说，那我就去找你的导员，让你们导员评评理。我还可以到你们系，到你们这个班级，让你们这些学生评评理。要不是你答应和我搞对象，我可能给你花这些钱吗？你既然不要脸，我也豁得出去。我看你毕业证能不能顺利拿到手，你妈的。”
张雪怒不可遏：“陈明你现在要不走我找人收拾你。”
content_en:
Chapter 526: Solve the heartache
Zhang Xue was still dreaming about his rich wife, but at this time Chen Chu had already begun to reflect on and absorb the yin energy he had received.
When she was with Zhang Xue, Zhang Xue's Yin Qi reached 85%. Of course, these Yin Qi are not very pure, and there are too many entanglements of interests mixed in them.
And Chen Chu also felt that 85% was quite a lot, after all, he was just a youngster. And if this guy doesn't get there first, other men may get it. As long as he is rich and powerful, this Zhang Xue will definitely contribute.
Moreover, she is now in her second year of college and is in her third year of junior college. If she does not find a destination for herself this year, it will be worthless in a year or two.
Moreover, people like Zhang Xue only love themselves and never love others. It's rare to have your feelings for yourself heated up to 85% because of the entanglement of interests.
At this time, Chen Chu reorganized the scope of his small world again, from 1,700 square kilometers to 1,900 square kilometers. Although it was smaller than the previous progress, it was not easy. This Zhang Xue himself has done his duty by using her waste.
After finishing it, Chen Chu called his cousin Chen Ming: "Xiao Ming, I want to tell you something."
Chen Ming sighed and said firmly: "Brother, did you take down that bitch Zhang Xue?"
"That's right. Xiao Ming, are you angry?"
"Brother, why am I angry? It's too late for me to thank you. That bitch really caused me misery. I was her licking dog for two years, but I didn't expect you to take her down in just a few days. It's not worth it for this kind of woman."
"That's right, Xiao Ming, you can go to him and ask for money now, and he will definitely give it to you now."
Master Chen understood that his cousin's heart was tied to the 20,000 yuan, and his kind heart was deceived. This place must be recovered, and one's own money must be recovered by oneself. Even the 200,000 and 200,000 given by others cannot resolve this knot.
"Okay, little brother, I listen to you."
"Xiao Ming, do you want me to give you an idea and tell you how to do it?"
"No need, little brother. I understand."
At this time, Chen Ming was extremely thoughtful. After talking to Chen Chu on the phone, Chen Ming called Zhang Xue directly, but Zhang Xue didn't answer the phone after several calls.
Chen Ming went directly to the Medical College. He was in his mid-twenties and entered the campus directly, and the guard did not stop him.
Then he arrived downstairs at Zhang Xue's apartment and shouted loudly: "Zhang Xue, come down here. When will you pay me back the 20,000 yuan you owe me?"
Zhang Xue, who was lying upstairs after just calling a few times, got up and went downstairs: "Chen Ming, it turns out it's you, a poor man. Why did you come to me?"
"Zhang Xue, since you called me a poor man, you must not be short of money. Then we should settle the 20,000 yuan you cheated me of today."
"Fart, when did I defraud you of the 20,000 yuan? It was all because you were cheap and you were willing to spend it on me."
"Haha, is it Zhang Xue? If you say that, then I will go to your instructor and let your instructor evaluate the theory. I can also go to your department and your class and let you students evaluate the theory. If you hadn't agreed to have a date with me, would I have spent this money on you? Since you are shameless, I will go out of my way. Let me see if you can get your diploma smoothly, damn you."
Zhang Xue was furious: "Chen Ming, if you don't leave now, I'll find someone to deal with you."
